text: 【四川2026上半年GDP达3.36万亿元 同比增长4.8%】7月16日，四川省统计局官微消息，根据地区生产总值统一核算结果，2026年上半年四川地区生产总值（GDP）为33629.45亿元，按不变价格计算，同比增长4.8%。其中，第一产业增加值1953.46亿元，同比增长3.6%；第二产业增加值11641.08亿元，增长4.9%；第三产业增加值20034.92亿元，增长4.8%。分产品看，锂离子电池增长62.7%，智能电视增长52.2%，集成电路增长18.6%，工业机器人增长15.7%。
text_en: [Sichuan's GDP for First Half of 2026 Reaches 3.36 Trillion Yuan, Up 4.8% YoY] On July 16, the Sichuan Provincial Bureau of Statistics reported via official WeChat that, based on unified GDP calculations, Sichuan's GDP for the first half of 2026 was 3.362945 trillion yuan, up 4.8% year-on-year at constant prices. Among this, the primary industry added value was 195.346 billion yuan, up 3.6%; the secondary industry added value was 1.164108 trillion yuan, up 4.9%; the tertiary industry added value was 2.003492 trillion yuan, up 4.8%. By product, lithium-ion batteries grew 62.7%, smart TVs grew 52.2%, integrated circuits grew 18.6%, and industrial robots grew 15.7%.
